PickItem.description: One selectable item of a `view/pick` request.

id.description: The id the server receives back; the client displays `label`.

description: `view/pick`: a typed selection request the server is waiting on.

URI of a server-rendered view that offers the same choice when the

multi.description: Whether more than one item may be selected.
